note: Official Polymarket constraints. Every value carries the source it was read from. Nothing here is derived from this SDK's Java code.

collateral.note: Standard ERC-20 on Polygon, backed 1:1 by USDC, backing enforced onchain.

orderStruct.expirationNote: source: clob-openapi.yaml — expiration remains in the POST /order wire body for GTD handling but is NOT part of the signed Order struct.
orderStruct.timestampUnitNote: The two exchanges disagree: place-orders documents <unix_milliseconds> for V2, combos/market-makers documents <unix_seconds> for V3. Keep them separate; do not normalise.

gtd.note: GTD orders expire one minute before their stated expiration. For an effective lifetime of N seconds use now + 60 + N. The expiration must be at least 3 minutes in the future.

settlement.note: POST /order and POST /orders return tradeIDs instead of transactionHashes on FAK/FOK matches. Poll trades by tradeID until each has a hash or returns FAILED.

minimumSize.contradiction: Official sources conflict on units. Keep both; sign against the live CLOB shares value only. Never merge or substitute one for the other.

orderBookOrdering.contradiction: Official sources disagree about bid/ask level ordering on the wire. Always sort levels numerically before any depth calculation.

tickGrid.fallback: none - an unrecognised tick must throw before any amount is calculated
tickGrid.provenance: MIXED. 0.0025 is confirmed by the 2026-07-02 changelog entry (World Cup markets). The CLOB OpenAPI spec documents tick_size as a free string with no enum, so the full six-value grid comes from this repo's own live verification (1.0 Ticket 023), not from a single official list. Re-confirm against a live /book sweep before relying on it.
